title: YouTube live chat popout
note: Selectors cross-checked by reading Social Stream Ninja's sources/youtube.js (GPL-3.0, see NOTICE). The popout form live_chat?is_popout=1&v=<id> is the one that source itself navigates to; `embed_domain` is only needed by the embedded chat iframe, not by the popout. In the EU YouTube may show a cookie-consent page first: the pack sets the consent PREFERENCE cookie SOCS (not a login) and reports 'consent' if the page asks anyway.

consent.detail: YouTube is showing its cookie-consent page instead of the chat; the reader never clicks, so nothing is read

disabled.detail: YouTube says chat is disabled or unavailable for this video (not live, chat off, or members-only)

replay.detail: this is a chat replay of a finished video, not a live stream; replay lines are not shown
